name: Abanilla (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first quarter of the four red bars of Aragon on yellow, the second and third white and the fourth red, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Abanilla.
history: Municipal flag of Abanilla; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: four red bars in the first quarter
Abanilla arms — castles, lions and the bars of Aragon within an ornate frame
